title: India is now the top country of origin for immigrant founders of US billion-dollar startups
sources: Business Standard, June 2026 - India-born founders behind 96 US unicorns, highest among immigrants: NFAP study
National Foundation for American Policy (NFAP), June 2026 - Immigrants and US Billion-Dollar Companies, Policy Brief
caption:
Immigrants founded or co-founded 59% of America's billion-dollar startups. No country contributed more of them than India.

India-born founders are behind 96 US unicorns - more than any other country of origin, per a June 2026 NFAP study - ahead of Israel (60), the UK (47) and China (41). Six Indian-origin founders, including Mohit Aron, Jyoti Bansal and Arvind Jain, have each founded multiple billion-dollar companies. The collective value of all immigrant-founded billion-dollar companies hit $5.0 trillion in 2026, up from $168 billion just ten years earlier.

This isn't one breakout founder's story. It's a pattern repeating often enough that it stopped being a coincidence a while ago.

Sources: Business Standard, NFAP (2026)
